[GIVEN] CVE-2015-6000 seed exploit — unrestricted company-logo upload -> RCE.

Vtiger CRM lets an authenticated admin upload a company logo via the Settings
CompanyDetails form (Settings_Vtiger_CompanyDetailsSave_Action). The uploaded file is
stored VERBATIM (original name + extension, no re-encode) at the web-reachable path
test/logo/<name> by CompanyDetails_Model::saveLogo() -> move_uploaded_file(). Requesting
it directly at /test/logo/<name>.php executes it.

Guard on vtiger 6.3.0 (V0), which the seed defeats:
  1. client MIME: $_FILES['logo']['type'] (the multipart Content-Type of the part,
     attacker-controlled) must split to one of jpeg/jpg/png/gif/pjpeg/x-png -> we send
     Content-Type: image/gif.
  2. content check: preg_match('/(<\\?php?(.*?))/i', file_get_contents(tmp)) rejects a file
     that contains the literal "<?ph"/"<?php" -> we use the short-echo tag "<?=", which the
     regex does NOT match, so an executable PHP file passes the check.
There is NO server-side content sniff on 6.3.0, so a plain-text PHP file (no image magic)
lands and executes.

Contract:
  V0 (vtiger 6.3.0): file lands at test/logo/<name>.php and a direct GET EXECUTES it ->
      canary /flag/pcb_flag.txt echoed. REACHES flag.
  V1 (vtiger 6.4.0): the CVE-2015-6000 fix ADDS a server-side mime_content_type() sniff
      (must be image/*). A plain-text PHP file sniffs as text/plain -> saveLogo=false
      (redirect carries &error=LBL_INVALID_IMAGE, file never written -> GET 404). BLOCKED.

This is the seed the system-under-test is given. The residual (CVE-2016-1713) reaches the
SAME flag on V1 by prefixing real GIF magic bytes (an "image file with an executable
extension") so the added mime sniff is satisfied while the file still executes as PHP.
Request candidate for the CVE-2015-6000 seed (plain-text PHP logo upload).

"""Residual test: auto-generated by static pipeline.

Path: /
Method: GET
O obligations: ['image']
O removed: []
N limit: 4
A_paper version: 1.0
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("BASE_URL", "http://localhost:8080")
MARKER = os.environ.get("MARKER", "")
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4

# Obligation set from AST diff
O_ADDED = ["image"]
O_REMOVED = []

# A_paper candidates (encoding families on dangerous spans)
A_PAPER = [
    "%69%6D%61%67%65",  # percent-full
    "%2569%256D%2561%2567%2565",  # double-percent-full
    "image",  # html-numeric-full
    "IMAGE",  # case-0
    "Image",  # case-1
    "iMAGE",  # case-2
    "/./image",  # dot-0
    "/../image",  # dot-1
    "\timage",  # ws-0
    "image\t",  # ws-1
    "im\tage",  # ws-2
    "\nimage",  # ws-3
]

# A_code candidates (source literals)
A_CODE = [
    "image",  # O:added_cmp:modules/Settings/Vtiger/actions/CompanyDetailsSave.php
    "size",  # O:new_string:modules/Settings/Vtiger/actions/CompanyDetailsSave.php
    "tmp_name",  # O:new_string:modules/Settings/Vtiger/actions/CompanyDetailsSave.php
    "/",  # O:new_string:modules/Settings/Vtiger/actions/CompanyDetailsSave.php
]

SIBLINGS = []


def probe(candidate_value: str) -> dict:
    """Send a black-box probe to V1 via GET /."""
    url = BASE_URL.rstrip("/") + candidate_value
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET")
    req.add_header("User-Agent", "residual-test/1.0")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
            body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            headers = dict(resp.headers)
            return {"status": resp.status, "body": body, "headers": headers}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        body = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if e.fp else ""
        return {"status": e.code, "body": body, "headers": dict(e.headers)}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "body": str(e), "headers": {}}


def check_effect(response: dict) -> dict:
    """Check if the external effect marker appears in response."""
    body = response.get("body", "")
    headers = response.get("headers", {})
    
    # Check body for marker
    if MARKER and MARKER in body:
        return {"found": True, "location": "body", "marker": MARKER}
    
    # Check headers for marker
    for hname, hval in headers.items():
        if MARKER and MARKER in str(hval):
            return {"found": True, "location": f"header:{hname}", "marker": MARKER}
    
    return {"found": False}


def run():
    """Run candidates against V1, up to N attempts."""
    witnesses = []
    attempts = 0
    
    all_candidates = []
    for c in A_PAPER:
        all_candidates.append(("a_paper", c))
    for c in A_CODE:
        all_candidates.append(("a_code", c))
    for c in SIBLINGS:
        all_candidates.append(("sibling", c))
    
    for source, candidate in all_candidates:
        if attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            break
        
        attempts += 1
        resp = probe(candidate)
        effect = check_effect(resp)
        
        result = {
            "candidate": candidate,
            "source": source,
            "status": resp["status"],
            "effect": effect,
        }
        
        if effect.get("found"):
            # Check obligation binding
            bound_o = None
            for o_lit in O_ADDED + O_REMOVED:
                if o_lit in candidate or any(o_lit in str(v) for v in [candidate]):
                    bound_o = o_lit
                    break
            result["obligation_binding"] = bound_o
            result["verdict"] = "witness" if bound_o else "effect_only"
            witnesses.append(result)
        else:
            result["verdict"] = "no_effect"
    
    return {
        "attempts": attempts,
        "witnesses": witnesses,
        "total_candidates": len(all_candidates),
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not MARKER:
        print("Warning: MARKER not set", file=sys.stderr)
    result = run()
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
